# Sanu Khan — Solution Architect, Tech Lead & Software Engineer (Dubai, UAE)

> Solution Architect, Tech Lead, and Platform Engineering Leader based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates with 13+ years designing enterprise integrations (SAP, Kafka, Azure), distributed platforms, and AI systems across retail, commercial aviation, automotive, real estate, healthcare, and SaaS environments.

## Architecture Case Studies

- [Enterprise Retail Integration](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/enterprise-retail-integration): Multi-market SAP ERP, PIM, and OMS event-driven integration architecture across 9 markets.
- [Airline NDC Retailing Aggregation](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/airline-retailing-aggregation): Multi-supplier flight booking and NDC retailing aggregation engine.
- [Automotive Omnichannel Platform](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/automotive-omnichannel-platform): Event-driven vehicle inventory, CRM, and lead orchestration system.
- [Real Estate ERP Architecture](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/real-estate-erp-architecture): Distributed property lifecycle, leasing, and financial reconciliation ERP platform.
- [Headless Healthcare Digital Experience](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/headless-healthcare-digital-experience): Unified patient portal, appointment orchestration, and headless CMS architecture.
- [Garage Management & Diagnostics](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/garage-management-and-diagnostics): Real-time fleet diagnostics and workshop workflow platform.
- [Zaakiy V3RSE Operational Intelligence](https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/zaakiy-v3rse): Autonomous AI agent orchestration, deterministic verification, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) runtime.
